what: A thin arrow (19×6) hidden at the bottom right of cards and links draws in from the left in .5s on hover. From .5s later it ticks every 1s, nudging 4px right and returning to place over the first 3/4, repeating until the pointer leaves (cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1))

options.--fx-shift: Tick bounce distance (via style), default 4px — sola .4rem
options.--fx-in: Entrance length = Wait until the first tick (in style), default .5s
options.--fx-ink: Arrow color (via style), default text color
options.[data-fx-part=arrow]: Arrow slot (empty span) — the slot is placed by the user (e.g. bottom right of the card)

use: Your card title here
note: CSS only — arrows are not shown on touch devices (the original also shows them only on (hover: hover))

from.where: shared.css .sl-arrow (cards·news rows·menu links·vertical nav — original arrowAnim: background position -1.9rem → 0 .5s, then every 1s translate(.4rem) → 0 (75%) repeating)

shared.css .nl-btn::after · .nl-arrow (corner-cut button · News row · card — original boxbutton: arrow mask position -2rem → 0 .5s cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1), then every 1s after .5s translate(.4rem) → 0 (75%) repeating. The button text arriving from 1.5rem to the right in .5s is handled on the site side)
